boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented recurring SRU practices, from finals-week breakfast to Homecoming rituals and campus cultural gatherings.

cards.title: Moonlight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Finals-week breakfast at Boozel Dining Hall
cards.notes: Watch SRU Dining and campus announcements near finals, then join the late-evening breakfast before exams begin.
cards.short_summary: A finals-week breakfast gathering that SRU identifies as one of its traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU describes Moonlight Breakfast, held the evening before final exams begin, as one of the University's traditions.
cards.access_notes: The cited 2022 event ran at Boozel Dining Hall from 9–11 p.m.; confirm each semester's announcement before going.

cards.title: The Main Street Homecoming Parade
cards.subtitle: Annual parade through Slippery Rock
cards.notes: Check the yearly Homecoming schedule, then find a public viewing spot along the announced Main Street route.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming's annual procession carries SRU spirit from Main Street toward campus.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU says its Homecoming tradition includes an annual parade that starts on Main Street and follows the route to Morrow Way and Campus Drive.
cards.access_notes: The route and start time can change by year; use SRU's current Homecoming announcement.

cards.entity_name: Paint The Town & Campus Window Wars
cards.title: Paint The Town & Campus Window Wars
cards.subtitle: Homecoming window-painting competition
cards.notes: Look for painted SRU-themed windows during Homecoming week; participating organizations should follow the current registration process.
cards.short_summary: Student groups turn local and campus windows into a Homecoming spirit display.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU identifies Paint The Town as an annual Homecoming activity in which student organizations and groups paint local-business and other windows.
cards.access_notes: Participation and locations are set through the annual Homecoming program; view the finished windows from public areas.

cards.title: Presenting Rock Royalty
cards.subtitle: Homecoming pep-rally recognition
cards.notes: Consult the Homecoming schedule for the pep rally and attend the public presentation of that year's Rock Royalty.
cards.short_summary: The Homecoming pep rally includes SRU's annual Rock Royalty presentation.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU's 2025 Homecoming announcement lists the presentation of Rock Royalty as part of the pep rally.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Homecoming program for eligibility, nomination details, location, and timing.

cards.title: Homecoming Pep Rally
cards.subtitle: The Quad's annual kickoff gathering
cards.notes: Start Homecoming at the scheduled Quad rally and watch the Marching Pride, Rock cheerleaders, and coaches' remarks.
cards.short_summary: A Homecoming kickoff that gathers SRU performers, cheerleaders, coaches, and community members.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU's 2025 Homecoming program scheduled a pep rally on The Quad with the SRU Marching Pride, Rock cheerleaders, annual coaches' speech, and Rock Royalty presentation.
cards.access_notes: Programming, location, and time are announced with each year's Homecoming schedule.

cards.title: The Homecoming Football Game
cards.subtitle: The Rock's Homecoming field tradition
cards.notes: Pair the parade with the announced football kickoff and follow SRU Athletics for ticketing and stadium-entry details.
cards.short_summary: Homecoming culminates with The Rock playing at Mihalik-Thompson Stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU's 2025 Homecoming announcement scheduled The Rock football team to host a game at Mihalik-Thompson Stadium during the festivities.
cards.access_notes: Game opponents, kickoff, and admission are seasonal; verify with SRU Athletics before attending.

cards.title: Veterans Day at the Alumni House
cards.subtitle: Annual ceremony outside Russell Wright Alumni House
cards.notes: Check SRU's November calendar for the ceremony and observe the student veterans' remembrance program respectfully.
cards.short_summary: An annual campus observance with music, colors, a wreath, and recognition of service.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU reported that it hosted an annual Veterans Day ceremony outside the Russell Wright Alumni House, including a wreath-laying and ROTC participation.
cards.access_notes: The observance's program and location should be confirmed through SRU's current Veterans Day communications.

cards.title: SRU's Chinese New Year Celebration
cards.subtitle: Chinese Culture Association and Chinese Club gathering
cards.notes: Follow SRU cultural-program announcements for the next celebration, which has included performances, games, trivia, and food.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding SRU-hosted Lunar New Year gathering organized with student cultural groups.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU reported that its Chinese Culture Association had hosted the University's Chinese New Year celebration for 12 years as of 2020.
cards.source_title: SRU marks Chinese New Year with Feb. 15 celebration
cards.access_notes: This event's date and venue follow the lunar calendar; verify the current SRU announcement before making plans.

cards.title: Earth Fest at Macoskey Center
cards.subtitle: Annual sustainability celebration
cards.notes: Watch Macoskey Center updates for the next Earth Fest, then choose from workshops, activities, vendors, and guided outdoor offerings.
cards.short_summary: A recurring SRU sustainability gathering centered at the Macoskey Center.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU described Earth Fest as its annual celebration at the Macoskey Center for Sustainability, Education and Research.
cards.source_title: SRU’s Macoskey Center to host annual Earth Fest, April 23
cards.access_notes: Dates and activity offerings vary; consult the Macoskey Center or SRU calendar for the current event.

cards.title: International Week
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide global-culture celebration
cards.notes: Review the annual program for talks, performances, and the International Dinner; attend the events that fit your schedule and budget.
cards.short_summary: A weeklong SRU tradition showcasing international students' cultures through campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: SRU announced its 45th Annual International Week as a seven-day celebration co-sponsored by the Office for Global Engagement, International Club, and Study Abroad Club.
cards.source_title: SRU International Week showcases students’ culture from across the globe
cards.access_notes: Individual events, including any ticketed dinner, have separate current details; consult SRU's program before attending.
